description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact? 
 
 This posting is for multiple opportunities ranging in years of experience.  Level of opportunity, including compensation, will be matched to a candidate's experienc e . 
 
 
 At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing—for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.
 
 Your greatest work is ahead! 
 
 Leidos’ Defense Sensors Open Air Sensors Portfolio is seeking a highly experienced Electronic Warfare Software Engineer to create unique solutions for complex challenges. With offices across the United States supporting defense, space, cyber, and commercial programs, Leidos Defense Sensor provides responsive, cost-effective engineering, scientific, and IT solutions.
 
 This position offers opportunities for both new and experienced engineers to advance their technical knowledge in sensor and radar systems. Our department values new ideas and encourages innovation across the many sensor projects that span the entire DoD ecosystem. Advancement opportunities into senior technical, project management, and personnel leadership roles are also available.
 
 If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!
 
 About the Leidos Defense Sensors 
 
 The Leidos Defense Sensors offers a broad portfolio of systems, solutions, and services spanning land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Our defense capabilities include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. We solve the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with critical, “can’t fail” missions.
 
 Primary Responsibilities 
 
 The selected candidate will support the design, implementation, and integration of advanced radar technologies into new and existing sensor programs. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 High-speed data acquisition

 Data distribution and real-time signal processing

 Modular software design

 Integration of COTS and custom technologies into prototype sensor systems

 Field testing of RF sensors and systems

 CONUS/OCONUS deployment of advanced sensor systems

 You will be assigned a wide variety of tasks related to the development of real-time prototype sensors. This role provides exposure to a broad range of software and computer engineering technologies, with opportunities to learn directly from experienced engineers and contribute meaningfully to multiple projects.
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 
 This posting is for multiple opportunities ranging in years of experience.  Level of opportunity, including compensation, will be matched to a candidate's experience. 
 
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science from an ABET-accredited institution plus 2-4 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience.

 Excellent teamwork skills

 Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of the following:

 Object-oriented software design principles

 Modern C++ development

 NVIDIA CUDA GPU development and optimization

 Linux and shell scripting

 Software design patterns

 Ability to apply these skills to radar and EW system development, digital signal processing, tracking algorithms, and field testing of sensor systems

 U.S. citizenship and an active Secret clearance 

 Residence in the North Alabama area or willingness to relocate to the Huntsville/North Alabama region

 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with MATLAB

 Understanding of signal processing fundamentals (sampling, Fourier analysis, etc.)

 Familiarity with development and collaboration tools such as GIT, JIRA, and CI/CD pipelines

 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
